Simon Marsh
simon.marsh@example.com | Boston, MA
Simon Marsh has 12 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Nimbus Dynamics (2022-2026), where they
designed internal Node.js standards used by 32+ downstream services. Before
that, Senior Backend Engineer at Timberline Data (2020-2022). Before that,
Backend Engineer at Ashgrove Labs (2014-2020). Education: M.S. Computer
Engineering, Northeastern University, 2014; B.S. Computer Engineering, SMU,
2012. Core skills: PostgreSQL, Distributed systems, AWS, Redis, REST API
design, Kubernetes, TypeScript, GraphQL, Docker, Node.js.
